name: Spirit Window
description: Spirits trapped inside a haunted window harm those who touch the window.
disable: DC 48 Occultism check (legendary) to free the spirits from the mirror, or DC 48 Religion check (legendary) to banish the spirits

offensiveAbilities.name: Siphon Soul
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature touches the window

Effect The triggering creature takes 8d10 + 44 void damage (DC 42 basic Will save) as the window attempts to steal their soul. If this damage would kill the target, its soul is trapped inside the window with the effects of Seize Soul.
